envelope.description: Daemon methods repo.settings.get, repo.settings.set and repo.trackerConfig.ensure

body.title: Daemon methods repo.settings.get, repo.settings.set and repo.trackerConfig.ensure
body.summary: Register the three IPC methods in the daemon, built and validated in the order get, set, ensure: exact registered-path check, one strict read and resolution from that snapshot, the exhaustive sign-in mapping from whoAmI on s1's adapter (read only), policy rows from PolicyReader, validation and refusal of non-local keys, writes through writeRepoEntryKeys, and the trackerConfig patch (type github, owner, repo, pushTasks true, commitArtifacts true). Business errors are returned as data.
acceptanceChecks: get returns what set wrote and a write made outside the daemon on the next get; get never writes github.json or the policy file
set refuses policy and status rows, unknown keys, invalid values (including branchPattern) and unregistered or aliased repo paths with the right code and writes nothing
A fake gh shows only the signed-in-user read runs, once, when the type is github and none when the type is none, and every PortResult failure maps to a sign-in state
get and set on malformed files return github-json-unreadable and leave the bytes untouched; get reads the file once
ensure writes the five keys in one write, returns changed false when already complete, and refuses unregistered repos and invalid owner or name; concurrent set calls through the socket both land
